title: Meta Conversions API Gateway Auto-Diagnostics & Signal Quality Scoring
body:
* Real-time Event Match Quality (EMQ) auto-diagnostics inside the CAPI Gateway dashboard
* Instant parameter drop-off alerts for customer data parameters (fbp, fbc, hashed email, and IP address)
* Automatic root-cause detection when server-side events fail to fire before ad set delivery is throttled
* Prevents silent attribution leakage when landing page scripts fail or cookies are blocked

title: Native Flow Forms & 1-Click Verification inside WhatsApp Cloud API
body:
* Native flow templates allowing businesses to deploy structured multi-step qualification forms directly within WhatsApp chat
* Real-time CRM syncing and automated sales agent assignment within sub-60-second response windows
* One-click OTP phone number validation eliminating fake and mistyped leads at point of entry
* Automated webhook triggers for instant lead routing to sales reps based on form responses
